text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali receives report from head of human rights committee, Rachid Driss, on activities of committee during 1996.
- Expansion of La Goulette port scheduled to end in February at cost of eight million dinars (about $8 million).
- Ben Ali meets Union Democratique Unioniste party head, Abderrahmen Tlili, to discuss political, economic and social issues.
